text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arafat warns of another Intifada if Israeli measures against Palestinians continue.
- Government sets up committee to choose pumping station for Toshka Development Project.
- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid says government to sell 34 companies between now and the end of the year.
- Investigations continue into mall fire -- extinguishers were out of order and lack of ventilators increased number of wounded.
- Egyptian-U.S. cooperation in order to use satellites for civil aviation safety.
- Arafat discussed U.S. envoy's visit and current peace crisis with presidential adviser Osama el-Baz in telephone conversation.
